text:
Maya: Finalizing the run-of-show for the Apr 7 webinar on Practical Inference Economics. Need final speaker order + who owns demo failover. Draft below — please ack or propose changes by EOD Wed.

Alex: Ack. Can we swap demo order so Nico presents first? Their demo is lower-risk and shorter.

Jin: I can own the fallback script if demo fails. Would like a short ops checklist for the sequence to trigger (and rollback).

Sophie: Slides are mostly ready — uploading v3 to the shared drive now. Can we move Q&A to last 20m instead of 15? More time for audience examples.

Maya: Good call Sophie — updated in the draft below.

Nico: I can do demo 1. Heads up: I need ~10 extra mins to warm model cache before we go live. Ops: what’s the signal for warming?

OpsBot: Reminder: rehearsal scheduled Thu 4/4 10:00 PDT. Join: https://zoom.example/rehearsal (ops checklist will run 15m before). :wave: 

Alex: Ops — can we add to pre-show checklist: warm cache, confirm fallback endpoint, run quick /health on endpoints, confirm captions?

InfraOps: Yep. We'll add a pre-show webhook that hits /warm-cache (3x requests with varying prompts), verifies /health for both primary and fallback, and posts a status update in this channel.

Maya: Here’s the updated run-of-show (short). Paste into your notes/slides if helpful:

```
18:00 PDT - Doors open / pre-roll
18:05 - Host intros + agenda (Maya) - 5m
18:10 - Keynote: Cost-first inference patterns (Alex) - 12m
18:22 - Demo 1: Fast routing + caching (Nico) - 12m (warm cache 10m prior)
18:34 - Demo 2: Quantization & unit economics (Nico/Alex) - 10m
18:44 - Panel: Engineering tradeoffs + tooling (Maya, Jin, Sophie) - 20m
19:04 - Q&A live (All) - 20m
19:24 - Close + CTA (Maya) - 5m
```

Jin: For rehearsal I'll run two mock failures: 1) model OOM (simulate heavy seq) -> trigger fallback to quantized-v2 endpoint; 2) region outage -> reroute to us-east. Ops, please confirm the endpoint names.

InfraOps: Confirmed endpoints: primary: /v1/generate/prod, fallback: /v1/generate/quant-v2, region fallback: us-east cluster. We'll provide a short curl script for the rehearsal.

Sophie: Who's on stage ops during the live? Alex volunteers. @Alex

Alex: I’ll be on stage for demo handoff and monitor slack + ops channel. Jin you run the failover steps if needed.

Maya: Final asks before rehearsal: 1) slide deck uploaded to drive by EOD Thu 2) bios + headshots for panelists in the shared folder 3) rehearsal record + timecode notes posted after dry run. Tag me when done.

Nico: Noted. Uploading deck v4 to drive now, adding a 1-slide fallback explainer.

Maya: Thanks all. :thumbsup:

OpsBot: Note: rehearsal will be recorded and auto-uploaded to #marketing-recordings. If you need local copy, ping infra.

Alex: One last note — let's add a 1-line benchmark slide showing latency/cost tradeoffs for the demo so we can speak to unit economics (we'll use the 95th pct numbers).

Maya: Good idea. Sophie can you draft that slide and share by tomorrow?

Sophie: On it — will pull the latest metrics and drop into slide v4.

Maya: Perfect. If no objections, I’ll lock run-of-show at EOD and send calendar invites for the final rehearsal.

Alex: No objections from me.

Jin: All good.

Nico: Good.

Maya: Locking then — thanks everyone.
